parameters.query:
SELECT id, email, name, notification_settings
FROM users
WHERE created_at < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND status = 'active'
ORDER BY created_at ASC;

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_tasks,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active') AS still_active,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'
                      AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
                      AND due_date IS NOT NULL
                      AND completed_at::date <= due_date) AS on_time,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'high') AS high_priority,
    ROUND(AVG(confidence_score)) AS avg_confidence,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 7) AS completed_this_week,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - 7) AS created_this_week
  FROM tasks
  WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.id }}'
    AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
),
streak AS (
  SELECT MAX(streak_count) as best_streak
  FROM user_streaks
  WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.id }}'
  AND streak_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT
  s.*,
  COALESCE(st.best_streak, 0) as best_streak,
  ROUND((s.on_time::numeric / NULLIF(s.completed, 0)) * 100) AS on_time_rate,
  ROUND((s.completed::numeric / NULLIF(s.total_tasks, 0)) * 100) AS completion_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN s.completed_this_week >= 10 AND s.on_time_rate >= 80 THEN 'top_performer'
    WHEN s.completed_this_week >= 5 THEN 'consistent'
    WHEN s.completed_this_week > 0 THEN 'building_momentum'
    ELSE 'needs_attention'
  END AS productivity_level
FROM stats s
CROSS JOIN streak st;
